name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement, a new stack guide, or a new heuristic
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What & why

What should reconstruct do, and what problem does it solve?

## Kind of change

- [ ] New / improved **stack guide** (`references/stack-guides/`) — which stack?
- [ ] New deterministic **candidate hint** or detection (`src/detect/`)
- [ ] PRD / output structure improvement
- [ ] Other

## Notes

For a stack guide, link docs for where routes/endpoints, the data model, and entry points
live in that stack. For a heuristic, describe the cheap, framework-agnostic signal.
